cards.facts: Ping sends ICMP Echo Requests to check IP reachability and reports round-trip times. It is not a bandwidth/throughput speed test. Distinguish delay, packet loss, and bandwidth; lack of a reply alone does not prove a host is down.
HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 commonly use TCP. HTTP/3 maps HTTP semantics over QUIC, which incorporates TLS 1.3. Do not assert that all HTTP or all TLS connections require TCP; qualify the version/transport.

TCP provides a reliable, in-order byte stream using sequence numbers, acknowledgments and retransmissions. Its transport guarantees should not be described as a guarantee against every application error.

Conventional system RAM is volatile working memory and loses contents when power is removed. SSD is non-volatile storage for persisted files. They serve complementary roles. This evidence does not establish immunity to heat, device failure, or data loss; do not promise such immunity.
